headline: Tax repricing and fund selling beat weak credit data; CDB 10Y spread hits 11bp, CGB 10Y at 1.612%
summary: CGBs fell for a third day even as October credit data disappointed: the CCDC 10-year rose 0.9bp to 1.612% (+2.6bp on the week) and the 30-year 0.6bp to 2.060% (+3.2bp), with the 7-year leading the week (+4.0bp to 1.440%) while the 2-year held near 1.23%. Policy banks sold off far harder: CDB 10-year rose 3.4bp on Friday and 8.6bp on the week to 1.722%, widening its spread over CGB to 11.0bp from 5.0bp on Tuesday, while ADBC and EXIM 10-year rose 6.7bp on the week and CDB 7-year 9.4bp.
drivers: Policy banks reprice for a bond tax

CDB, ADBC and EXIM 5–20Y rose 2–5bp on Friday after 2.5–3.2bp on Thursday, taking the CDB 7-year spread over CGB to 20.4bp and the 10-year to 11.0bp, both above their 1-year averages. Huachuang's argument is spreading: if new CGBs become taxable, policy bank bonds lose their relative appeal and must reprice against higher after-tax CGB yields, though it also calls part of the move overdone.
Weak credit ignored by crowded books

October new loans fell by RMB100bn against a small expected gain and TSF was RMB1.15tn versus RMB1.42tn expected, with loan growth at a record-low 4.7%. Normally that would rally bonds, but with term and sector spreads near record lows, funds and brokers kept selling; 30-year futures volatility has climbed to its highest since September and the TL contract fell 0.36% at settle.
PBOC adds cash before the tax deadline

The PBOC added RMB364bn of overnight reverse repos at 1.25% and RMB300bn of 7-day repos against RMB384bn maturing, a net RMB280bn, plus RMB100bn of treasury cash deposits at 1.30%. Brokers say overnight repo needs to fall back below 1.35% after the Nov 16 tax payment date for bonds to steady.

US 10-year Treasury yields jumped about 13bp to 5.13% on Thursday after a weak 30-year auction, adding to global duration selling. ChiNext fell 3.32% and the Shanghai Composite 0.59%, but redemption worries in credit and convertibles (−1.97%) meant the stock slide gave bonds no lift. MoF's 3-year and 10-year auctions still drew 3.07 and 4.32 times cover.

view: Neutral for the next 1–2 weeks, with the 10-year expected in a 1.58–1.64% CCDC range. The sell-off is about positioning and the tax headline rather than fundamentals: credit is contracting, CPI is 0.7%, and the PBOC is adding cash, so I still buy the 10-year on a back-up to 1.62–1.63% and keep the 5Y-into-10Y flattener. Policy bank spreads are now back at or above their 1-year averages from 5Y to 20Y, so I close the CGB-over-CDB 20Y trade near target and stand ready to buy CDB 10Y at a 12bp spread, while the CDB 7Y spread trade sits right at its stop. An official tax plan would push the 10-year through 1.64% and widen policy bank spreads further; soft October activity data on Monday and calmer funding after the tax date would pull it back toward 1.58%.

buckets.name: CGB 1–2Y
buckets.why: The 2-year rose 1.6bp this week to 1.232% but is still near its 1-year low (7th percentile, average 1.303%), and the 1-year is 1.174%. The PBOC added a net RMB280bn on Friday and resumed 7-day repos, yet with easing played down the front end has little room to rally.
buckets.call: Hold; add 2-year CGBs only above 1.27%, or if the overnight rate is cut below 1.25%.

buckets.name: CGB 5–7Y belly
buckets.why: 2s5s10s is −18.3bp (3rd percentile, average −7.9bp), so the 5-year at 1.331% stays rich, while the 7-year led the week's sell-off (+4.0bp to 1.440%) and lifted 5s7s10s to −6.3bp (15th percentile) ahead of the Nov 18 RMB150bn 7-year special CGB. The 5s10s flattener opened at ~29bp is at 28.2bp (65th percentile, average 26.6bp), still open and modestly in the money.
buckets.call: Keep the 5Y-into-10Y switch (5s10s flattener) from ~29bp, target 25bp, stop 31bp.

buckets.name: CGB 10Y
buckets.why: The 10-year rose 2.6bp this week to 1.612%, 2.5bp above its 1-year low (3rd percentile, average 1.755%); the 1.62–1.63% buy zone has not yet traded. Against neighbours it screens cheap: 7s10s20s is −26.2bp (76th percentile, average −29.5bp), and Friday's MoF 10-year tap drew 4.32 times cover.
buckets.call: Buy 10-year CGBs on a back-up to 1.62–1.63%, target 1.58%, stop 1.66%.

buckets.name: CGB 30Y
buckets.why: The 30-year rose 3.2bp this week to 2.060% and TL futures fell 0.36% at settle on Friday, but 10s30s is only 44.7bp (35th percentile, average 45.9bp), so the long end has moved with the 10-year rather than cheapened. 30s50s is 12.4bp (8th percentile); insurer and year-end allocation demand should cap the long end.
buckets.call: Neutral. Add above 2.10% (10s30s ~46bp); poor risk/reward below 2.03%.

buckets.name: Policy banks 2–10Y vs CGB
buckets.why: The CDB 10-year spread widened another 2.5bp on Friday to 11.0bp (60th percentile, average 9.7bp), 6bp wider on the week, so last Thursday's close of the CDB-into-CGB switch at ~8.5bp was well timed. At 2Y policy banks are still tight (CDB 12.2bp, 4th percentile), so value is at 10Y, not the front.
buckets.call: Buy CDB 10Y vs CGB 10Y at 12bp or wider, target 9bp, stop 15bp; avoid 1–3Y policy banks.

buckets.name: Policy banks 5–7Y vs CGB
buckets.why: The trade is under water: CDB 7-year rose 4.6bp on Friday to 1.644% and its spread over CGB jumped 3.4bp to 20.4bp (77th percentile, average 15.8bp), 0.1bp from the 20.5bp stop. ADBC 5-year is now 18.9bp over CGB, its widest in a year, which shows the tax repricing is broad; I keep the stop rather than chase, as an official tax plan could push spreads to their 24bp highs.
buckets.call: Hold CDB 7Y vs CGB 7Y from 17–18bp, target 14bp, stop 20.5bp (a close above ends it); re-enter at 23bp+.

buckets.name: ADBC/EXIM vs CDB 10Y
buckets.why: ADBC 10-year yields 1.4bp more than CDB (54th percentile, average 1.4bp) and EXIM only 0.4bp (3rd percentile, average 2.0bp) after CDB led the sell-off and gained another 0.8bp on both. ADBC's pickup has halved this week and sits just above the 1bp switch-back level.
buckets.call: Hold ADBC 10Y over CDB 10Y; switch back to CDB if the pickup falls below 1bp. Avoid EXIM 10Y at 0.4bp.

buckets.name: Policy banks 20–30Y
buckets.why: Near target: the CDB 20-year spread over CGB widened 4.6bp this week to 9.5bp (52nd percentile, average 10.4bp), from 7.3bp on Thursday and a 14th-percentile reading a week ago. With the spread back at its average the edge is gone; the 30-year spread is 11.0bp (19th percentile).
buckets.call: Closed CGB 20Y over CDB 20Y at ~9.5bp, just short of the 10bp target; re-enter below 7bp.
